'''Jerry Fans''' were [[NPCs]] that appeared in the {{Zone|Village}} during [[April Fools]] in 2022 and 2023.

== Appearances ==
[[File:April fools 2022 hub.png|227px|Jerry Fans]]
[[File:April fools 2022 hub2.png|227px|Jerry Fans]]

Jerry Fans surround a big picture of [[Jerry]] displaying on where the [[Hub Map]] is usually at. They hold a staring angle towards the center of the picture.
